{{Quote|Sleep well, my child, tonight.''<br />''Though the forest is filled with light,''<br />''Close your sweet eyes,''<br />''While the sun flies''<br />''Over the mountains. Good night.|A Ghostling lullaby|<ref name="Ghost">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''</ref>}}
The '''sun''' of the [[Datar system/Legends|Datar system]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] regions<ref name="Region" /> was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Datar/Legends|Datar]].<ref name="Twitter" /> In the early [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] trailblazer [[Gan Basso]] [[Death/Legends|died]] when he accidentally crashed his [[Gan Basso's starship|vessel]] into the [[Star/Legends|star]] after a hasty hyperspace jump.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The [[Ghostling]]s, the natives of Datar, sung about their planet's sun in at least one lullaby.<ref name="Ghost" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Datar [[Star system/Legends|system's]] sun was first mentioned in ''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]'', a junior novel written by [[Dave Wolverton]] and published in [[January]] [[2000]].<ref name="Ghost" />
